entities.summary: Albert Leo "Alberto" van Klaveren Stork is a Dutch-born Chilean lawyer, political scientist, and diplomat who served as Minister of Foreign Affairs (2023–2026). Previously, he served as the Undersecretary for Foreign Affairs of Chile between 2006 and 2009. Van Klaveren also represented Chile in the International Court of Justice in the case regarding the Chilean–Peruvian maritime dispute. Before assuming his post as a minister, he taught at the University of Chile.
